units.title: 舟船·凡卜买船断同船户：买船和雇船断法相同；船家自己占，要按船家的家宅来断，不用这个断法

rule.yi: 占买船和雇船，断法相同，按船户（船的主人）的办法断；如果是船家自己占，就要按船家的家宅来断，不是这里的断法。
rule.en: Divining the buying of a boat and the hiring of one are judged in the same way, as for the boat's household; if the boatman divines for himself, it should be judged as for the boat family's household, which is not the method given here.

yi: 凡是占买船，
按船户（船的主人）的办法断
en: In divining the buying of a boat,
judge it as for the boat's household

zh: 凡卜买船与雇船，断法相同；
如舟子自卜，当以船家宅断之，又非此断法也。
yi: 凡是占买船和雇船，断法相同；
如果是船夫自己占，应当按船家的家宅来断，不是这里的断法。
en: Divining the buying and the hiring of a boat are judged in the same way;
if the boatman divines for himself, it should be judged as for the boat family's household, which is not the method given here.

units.title: 舟船·六亲持世可推新旧之由：看船新旧用六亲持世——财福是新，父母是旧，兄弟半新半旧，官鬼多灾惊；兼看衰旺

rule.yi: 推断船的新旧，看哪一个六亲持世：财爻、福神持世是新船，父母爻持世是旧船，兄弟爻持世是半新半旧，官鬼持世则多灾多惊；还要兼看衰旺。
rule.en: To tell whether a boat is new or old, see which of the six relations holds the Self: Wealth or Output is new, Resource is old, Peer is half new and half old, and Pressure means many calamities and frights; strength and weakness are also taken into account.

yi: 六亲持世，
可以推断船新旧的缘由
en: By which of the six relations holds the Self,
one can work out the reasons for the boat being new or old

zh: 凡推船之新旧，当以六亲持世决之，财福是新，父母是旧，兄弟是半新旧，官鬼多灾惊。
yi: 凡是推断船的新旧，应当用六亲持世来决断：财福是新，父母是旧，兄弟是半新半旧，官鬼多灾多惊。
还要兼看衰旺来决断。
en: In judging whether a boat is new or old, decide by which of the six relations holds the Self: Wealth and Output are new, Resource is old, Peer is half new and half old, and Pressure means many calamities and frights.
Decide also by strength and weakness.

units.title: 舟船·诸鬼动临可识节病之处：金鬼钉少，土鬼灰少，木鬼有缝，水鬼有漏，火鬼有燥裂——船的毛病看哪一行的鬼爻发动

rule.yi: 船的毛病看是哪一行的鬼爻发动：金鬼是钉子少，土鬼是灰（油灰）少，木鬼是板缝，水鬼是漏水，火鬼是木头干燥裂开。
rule.en: The boat's faults are read from the element of the moving Pressure line: Metal Pressure means too few nails, Earth Pressure too little putty, Wood Pressure seams, Water Pressure leaks, and Fire Pressure dry cracks.

yi: 各种鬼爻发动临到（船上），
可以知道毛病所在的地方
en: When the various Pressure lines move and arrive,
one can tell where the faults lie

zh: 金鬼钉少，土鬼灰少，木鬼有缝，水鬼有漏，火鬼有燥裂。
yi: 金鬼是钉子少，土鬼是灰少，木鬼有缝，水鬼有漏，火鬼有干燥裂开。
en: Metal Pressure means too few nails, Earth Pressure too little putty, Wood Pressure has seams, Water Pressure leaks, and Fire Pressure dry cracks.

note.yi: 「节病」是船体各节、各处的毛病；「灰」指填船缝用的油灰。这一句按鬼爻所属五行断船的毛病，和疾病章按鬼爻五行断病位是同一种取法。
note.en: "Faults" here are the defects in the parts and joints of the hull, and "putty" is the caulking used to fill the seams. Reading a boat's faults by the element of Pressure is the same kind of reading as judging the seat of an illness by the element of Pressure in the chapters on illness.

units.title: 舟船·初二爻为前仓要持财福、五六爻为后舵怕见官兄：初二爻前仓，三四爻中仓，五六爻后舵

rule.yi: 初爻、二爻是船的前舱，最好是财爻、福神；五爻、六爻是船的后舵，怕见官鬼、兄弟；三爻、四爻是中舱。
rule.en: The first and second lines are the fore hold of the boat and are best carrying Wealth or Output; the fifth and sixth lines are the stern rudder and fear Pressure or Peer; the third and fourth lines are the middle hold.

yi: 初爻、二爻是前舱，
要有财爻、福神；
五爻、六爻是后舵，
怕见官鬼、兄弟
en: The first and second lines are the fore hold,
and want Wealth or Output;
the fifth and sixth lines are the stern rudder,
and fear to see Pressure or Peer

zh: 初二爻为前仓，三四爻为中仓，五六爻为后舵。
yi: 初、二爻是前舱，三、四爻是中舱，五、六爻是后舵。
en: The first and second lines are the fore hold, the third and fourth the middle hold, and the fifth and sixth the stern rudder.

units.title: 舟船·爻作梢公不宜伤克：占船以父母爻为舟船，占雇撑船的人以父母爻为梢公；要旺相、生合世爻，发动伤克世爻为凶

rule.yi: 占船，以父母爻代表船；占雇撑船的人，以父母爻代表船夫（梢公）；要旺相、生合世爻才吉，如果发动去伤克世爻就凶。
rule.en: In divining for a boat the Resource line stands for the boat, and in divining for the man hired to pole it the Resource line stands for the boatman; it is lucky if it is strong and gives life to or combines with the Self, and ill if it moves to injure or control the Self.

yi: 爻代表船夫（梢公），
不宜被伤克
en: The line stands for the boatman,
and should not be injured or controlled

zh: 卜船以父母为舟船，卜驾撑以父母爻为梢公。
要旺相生合世爻为吉，如发动伤克世爻，为凶。
yi: 占船以父母爻为舟船，占雇人驾船撑船以父母爻为梢公。
要旺相、生合世爻为吉，如果发动伤克世爻，为凶。
en: In divining for a boat the Resource line is the boat, and in divining for a man hired to steer and pole it the Resource line is the boatman.
It is lucky if it is strong and gives life to or combines with the Self, and ill if it moves to injure or control the Self.

units.title: 舟船·龙为舟尾岂可空刑：青龙是船尾，临财爻旺相发动、持世生合世爻，都主有利称意

rule.yi: 青龙代表船尾；临着财爻、旺相发动，或者持世、生合世爻，都主有利益、称心；不可落空或带刑。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon stands for the stern of the boat; carrying Wealth, strong and moving, or holding the Self or giving life to or combining with the Self, it brings profit and satisfaction; it must not be Void or carry punishment.

yi: 青龙是船尾，
怎么可以落空或带刑？
en: The Azure Dragon is the stern,
and how can it be Void or carry punishment?

zh: 青龙为船尾，临财旺动，持世生合世，皆主利益称意。
yi: 青龙是船尾，临着财爻旺相发动，持世、生合世爻，都主利益称意。
en: The Azure Dragon is the stern; carrying a strong moving Wealth line, or holding the Self or giving life to or combining with the Self, it brings profit and satisfaction.

units.title: 舟船·螣蛇辨索缆之坚牢：螣蛇是缆绳，休囚落旬空则枯烂，旺相带吉神则坚牢

rule.yi: 螣蛇代表缆绳：休囚或落旬空，缆绳枯烂；旺相而带吉神，缆绳坚牢。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake stands for the mooring rope: resting or trapped, or Void in its ten-day period, the rope is rotten; strong and carrying an auspicious spirit, the rope is firm.

yi: 螣蛇用来辨别缆绳是否坚牢
en: The Coiling Snake tells whether the mooring rope is firm

zh: 螣蛇为索缆，休囚值旬空则枯烂，旺相持吉神则坚牢。
yi: 螣蛇是缆绳，休囚、落旬空就枯烂，旺相、带吉神就坚牢。
en: The Coiling Snake is the rope; resting or trapped, or Void in its ten-day period, it is rotten; strong and carrying an auspicious spirit, it is firm.

units.title: 舟船·白虎为帆樯之顺利：白虎属风，取为风帆，生旺带财福吉神、持世生合身世则帆好风顺，带凶鬼恶煞克害世身或卦得反吟则有失风倾覆之患

rule.yi: 白虎属风，所以取它代表风帆：生旺、带财爻福神等吉神、发动持世或生合身世，船就有好帆，风顺而快；白虎带着凶鬼恶煞、旺而发动克害世爻和身，或者卦是反吟，会遭遇失风、倾覆的祸患。
rule.en: The White Tiger belongs to wind and so stands for the sail: if it is strong and carries Wealth, Output or other auspicious spirits, and moves to hold or give life to or combine with the Self and Body, the boat has a good sail and the wind is fair and quick; if the White Tiger carries baleful Pressure and evil stars, strong and moving to harm or control the Self and Body, or the hexagram is Reversed Chant, there is the danger of losing the wind and capsizing.

yi: 白虎代表风帆桅杆是否顺利
en: The White Tiger tells whether the sail and mast go well

zh: 白虎属风，故取为风帆，若生旺带财福吉神，动持生合身世，则船有好帆，使风顺快；
若白虎带凶鬼恶煞，旺动克害世身，或卦得反吟，主遭失风倾覆之患。
yi: 白虎属风，所以取它做风帆，如果生旺、带财爻福神等吉神，发动持世或生合身世，那么船有好帆，风顺而快；
如果白虎带着凶鬼恶煞，旺相发动克害世身，或者卦得反吟，主遭遇失风、倾覆的祸患。
en: The White Tiger belongs to wind and is taken for the sail; if it is strong and carries Wealth, Output or other auspicious spirits, and moves to hold or give life to or combine with the Self and Body, the boat has a good sail and the wind is fair and quick;

if the White Tiger carries baleful Pressure and evil stars, strong and moving to harm or control the Self and Body, or the hexagram is Reversed Chant, there is the danger of losing the wind and capsizing.

units.title: 舟船·六爻皆吉不伤身四海遨游无阻滞：六爻生合财福吉神，又生旺持世持身，动爻不来伤克，则无往不吉

rule.yi: 六爻都生合财爻、福神这样的吉神，又生旺、持世持身，发动的爻也不来伤克，就无往不吉，即使远游五湖四海也都顺利。
rule.en: If the six lines all give life to or combine with auspicious spirits such as Wealth and Output, are strong and hold the Self and Body, and no moving line comes to injure or control, then nothing goes amiss, and even a far voyage over the lakes and seas goes smoothly.

yi: 六爻都吉，没有伤到（世）身，
四海遨游都没有阻滞
en: If the six lines are all auspicious and do not harm the Self and Body,
one may roam the four seas without hindrance

zh: 六爻生合财福吉神，又生旺持世持身，动爻又不来伤克，则无往不吉，虽远游于五湖四海，亦皆顺利也。
yi: 六爻生合财爻、福神这样的吉神，又生旺、持世持身，动爻又不来伤克，就无往不吉，即使远游五湖四海，也都顺利。
en: If the six lines give life to or combine with auspicious spirits such as Wealth and Output, are strong and hold the Self and Body, and no moving line comes to injure or control, then nothing goes amiss, and even a far voyage over the lakes and seas goes smoothly.
